features.name: Crypto core
features.description: internal/pgp: file encrypt to public key (optional sign), decrypt with private key + passphrase (optional verify), armored/binary auto-detect, atomic output, cancel, typed errors
features.evidence: go test -race ./internal/pgp: roundtrip, wrong passphrase, wrong recipient, signer mismatch, unsigned-but-verify, tampered ciphertext, empty input, cancel, GnuPG interop both directions

features.name: Desktop UI with separate Encrypt and Decrypt menus
features.description: Fyne window, side tabs + Tools menu for Encrypt/Decrypt, file pickers, passphrase entry, overwrite confirm, busy state, cancel, error dialogs, remembered key paths
features.evidence: Xvfb + xdotool: both tabs render; decrypt of GnuPG-signed message via GUI produced plaintext (mode 0600) and 'Signature: valid'; missing key file shows error dialog

features.name: Non-root per-user install
features.description: pgp-tools --install / --uninstall: binary to ~/.local/bin, desktop entry + icon under XDG_DATA_HOME; no root
features.evidence: go test ./internal/install; manual run with isolated HOME created 755 binary, desktop entry, icon; uninstall removed all three

features.name: CI builds for Linux, Windows, macOS
features.description: .github/workflows/build.yml: test + portable binary artifact per OS
features.evidence: Workflow written; not yet observed green on GitHub runners

features.name: Release packaging
features.description: On v* tag: attach binaries to GitHub release; macOS .app via fyne package; Windows exe icon resource

features.name: Drag-and-drop input
features.description: Drop a file on the window to fill Input file of the active tab
